summary: Lloyds Banking Group filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 10,000,000 ordinary shares from Goldman Sachs International on June 3, 2026, at a volume-weighted average price of 99.9313 pence per share. These purchases are part of an existing share buyback programme announced on January 30, 2026. The shares are intended to be cancelled. This is a routine open-market buyback execution under a previously disclosed programme. The registrant is acting as the issuer returning capital to shareholders. Watch for completion of the buyback programme and any changes in cancellation volume.
